data.name: ASTALA MUERTE
data.detailed_description: A classic survival horror game where you explore interconnected environments, solve puzzles, and manage scarce resources as you investigate a seemingly abandoned facility hiding something far more dangerous beneath the surface. What begins as a routine investigation slowly unravels into a tense fight for survival, as deadly creatures and unnatural anomalies force you to question what really happened within these walls. Inspired by the golden era of survival horror, the experience emphasizes methodical exploration, backtracking through newly unlocked areas, environmental puzzles, limited inventory management, and deliberate combat where every encounter matters. As you piece together fragments of the truth, every step forward comes with risk, and not everything you encounter can be understood… or survived.

data.short_description: Step into the shadows of the past in this third-person survival horror game inspired by the golden age of PS1/PS2-era classics. Set in the 1990s, you’ll explore a forgotten underground laboratory where something went horribly wrong: dinosaurs walk again, and you're trapped in the aftermath.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
